notes.title: U.I Fix
notes.notes: Small U.I Fix in the hub. You only need 2 players to start the match and not 3.

Add: Level Select, 

Lowered: Player count from 100 to 5 to decrease the amount of lag.

Fixes: Terrain height in areas and fixed the hub level where you would get stuck.


Next update: New game mode, new characters 

Thank you for all the support and feedback. 

Happy Tagging :D
